sportsdataverse.basketball.vtb — 35 endpoints. Note: Owner flag: the VTB United League is run from Russia and several clubs are owned or sponsored by sanctioned state companies (the KHL precedent); Infobasket is the Russian basketball federation's stats platform. Fetching on your own machine is fine; any published data release, hosted mirror or redistribution needs owner (sanctions / legal) sign-off first. No accounts or payments are involved. Note: Unofficial and unsupported: both hosts are keyless public JSON backends of vtb-league.com. No terms of use are published; robots.txt is a 404 on api.vtb-league.com and org.infobasket.su (no rules; vtb-league.com disallows only /wp/wp-admin/). The runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included, and honours Retry-After on 429 / 503. No key, cookie or proxy is used (live-verified direct from the droplet 2026-10-12). Note: Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26) on both backends. Infobasket keys everything by competition id: vtb_infobasket_seasons maps the END year to the season-level CompID, and the season-keyed wrappers do that mapping for you. CompID means three things: a season (50714), a stage below it (50720 regular season, 54281 playoff; stage-level wrappers take the stage id from vtb_infobasket_comp_issue) and, in the player season stats, an END year. Note: Ids: the v2 matchId is the Infobasket GameID, the v2 teamId the Infobasket TeamID and the v2 venueId the Infobasket ArenaId. team_id is the key on every team route; comp_team_id (a registration in one stage) and the club-record id of the team page are other key spaces. person_id is one person across clubs and seasons. Note: Errors are HTTP 200: an unknown id answers {MessageType, Message}, an unknown game the string 'BadRequest'; both are AssetFetchError (a failed fetch), never an empty frame. A body for another game, person, team, competition or season than the one asked for is AssetFetchError too, as is a game that is not final (box score, plays and header need GameStatus 1) and a partial GetTeamStats page. An empty list is NoDataError. Note: Coverage: calendars and box scores from 2009-10; play-by-play and shot x/y from 2022-23 only (earlier games give an empty pbp frame), officials in the line-ups from 2022-23. Shot x/y are decimetres from the basket centre (orientation unverified). Counting statistics are null instead of 0 on the wire (the parsers fill 0), percentages and averages are comma-decimal strings (the parsers return floats), the paint statistics are broken and dropped, and dates come in three encodings (the parsers return ISO strings; .NET instants as Moscow time with its +03:00 offset). Note: Personal data: the runtime removes licence numbers, contact and operator-account fields for everyone and the birth dates, birth years and ages of coaches, referees and other officials from every body (also with return_parsed=False). Players' public bio (birth date, height, weight, nationality) is kept. Note: Stage CompIDs: the team routes (TeamRoster, TeamStats, TeamGames) also accept a stage CompID; pass it as params={'compId': 50720} instead of season. Other tags (vtbyouth, wbc, wpremier, rfb) answer through the tag argument; only vtb was captured.
